reviews.title: This can be a game changer for a low price!
reviews.comment: I’ve been using it for a week so far and it’s surprisingly good. Cables were easy to set up and very well identified during the put-together. I think it’s worth your buck and seems pretty well built. It says it’s made in China with Japanese components, so I guess it’s worth giving it a try. No noise at all at least for me and it’s giving me enough power for my setup.
reviews.author: Alejandro Landaeta

reviews.title: Es la primer vez que compro y estoy muy contento!
reviews.comment: Se ve de calidad,a caja esta bien segura y bien protegida, realmente es la primera vez que compro de esta marca por recomendacion de un amigo el precio y los material son realmente de buena calidad, recomiendo mucho ya la estoy probando y hasta ahora me funciona bien, realmente la alegria por esto producto es mas de lo que esperaba, creo que volvere a comerar mas adelante :D

reviews.title: Does not live up to expectation
reviews.comment:
Lasted 3 months and died.  The process to  submit a warranty claim was confusing but with persistence I was able to submit it
I let them know I followed their  recommended troubleshooting  steps and  provided all required information and order details and they were kind enough to issue a refund right away.
